page.overview:
What is Sixth Brother's lightsaber?

The Sixth Brother's lightsaber was utilized during his time as an Inquisitor of the Galactic Empire. The weapon would be destroyed slightly over a year after the formation of the Empire on the Outer Rim moon Raada, causing the Sixth Brother's death, when the Inquisitor fought the former Jedi Padawan Ahsoka Tano. Tano claimed the kyber crystals from the Sixth Brother's lightsaber for use in her own newly-constructed pair of lightsabers, after purifying them of the taint of the dark side.

The Sixth Brother's lightsaber design was based on that of the Grand Inquisitor's. It seemed to have some differences, such as the absence of the two spikes around the emitter. However, it did have protrusions around the handle guard during crescent and disc mode.

One feature that set it apart from other Inquisitor lightsabers was that this one had the capability of being a split saber, being able to disconnect the hilt so the user was able to use two lightsabers instead of one.

The weapon was powered by two kyber crystals, forcibly attuned to the dark side of the Force through the process known as bleeding. Ahsoka Tano believed that the crystals had been looted from the Jedi Temple following the Great Jedi Purge.
